problems.problem: Contact shadow under the bottle base is fainter and tighter than the shadows of the neighbouring ice cubes, so the bottle reads slightly lighter on the marble than theScene props.
problems.evidence: Ice cubes at left and bottom-right carry visible soft cast shadows and melt-water pools, while the bottle base at y≈960 shows only a minimal darkening (contact shadow opacity 0.4, blur 9, cast_opacity 0.1).
problems.repair: Strengthen and slightly widen the bottle's contact shadow and add a faint occlusion gradient in the marble immediately under the base to match cube shadow density.

problems.problem: Subtitle set in near-white cream over a pale cream wall/counter zone fails contrast and reads as a floating strip.
problems.evidence: Subtitle bbox [59,585,267,610] in #fff7ee sits over the light ivory wall and countertop; legibility drops sharply at reading size.
problems.repair: Recolor the subtitle to the deep maroon of the title (#52251e) or move it onto the blurred burgundy booth band for contrast.

problems.problem: Background contains props the cleared-counter concept excludes, and they clutter the mid-ground next to the product.
problems.evidence: A blurred tumbler glass at ~(240,630), a framed menu lying on the counter at ~(240,715) and a condiment bottle at ~(85,560) appear despite the 'bare countertop, no tableware' direction.
problems.repair: Regenerate or paint out the玻璃 tumbler, menu frame and condiment bottle so the counter reads cleared and the bottle owns the scene.

problems.problem: Bottle contact with the laminate is weak; the base sits with almost no occlusion shadow while the menu and glass cast clearer shadows.
problems.evidence: Base at y≈895 shows only a hairline darkening; perspective of the receding counter edge also makes the standing point feel slightly forward of the surface plane.
problems.repair: Add a soft elliptical contact shadow plus a subtle reflected warm bounce at the base consistent with the counter's sheen.

problems.problem: Ground contact is unconvincing: the bottle's shadow is a symmetric smudge while the arched recess implies a directional key from the left, so the bottle looks placed rather than standing.
problems.evidence: Base at y≈945 shows a uniform soft blob (opacity 0.4, blur 9, zero offset) with no cast direction, against stone floor gradients that fall left-to-right.
problems.repair: Give the contact shadow a slight rightward cast and darker core under the base heel, matching the recess-implied light direction.

reason: Motion is the only study with zero defects: the flat graphic satin field is intentional so no floor contact is required, the retained 180x650 source bottle (white-baked neck transmission intact, label fully legible) sits cleanly against the vermilion textile with no pasted edge, and the white headline/subtitle/footer hierarchy is crisp and on-brand. Ice is a close second but its bottle shadow is lighter than its props'; sculpture lacks directional contact; diner fails on subtitle contrast, stray tableware props and weak base contact. No nonsense lettering, clipping or light conflicts anywhere; scores reflect executed quality, not the mere presence of headlines.
